title: Cryptography with OpenSSL
description: Use OpenSSL to generate keys, encrypt files, and inspect certificates.

steps.title: Generate RSA key pair
steps.command:
openssl genrsa -out private.pem 2048
openssl rsa -in private.pem -pubout -out public.pem
steps.output:
Generating RSA private key, 2048 bit long modulus
.....+++++
...+++++
e is 65537 (0x10001)
writing RSA key
steps.explanation: Generate a 2048-bit RSA private key and extract the corresponding public key.

steps.title: Encrypt and decrypt a file
steps.command:
echo 'secret message' > plaintext.txt
openssl rsautl -encrypt -pubin -inkey public.pem -in plaintext.txt -out encrypted.bin
openssl rsautl -decrypt -inkey private.pem -in encrypted.bin
steps.output: secret message
steps.explanation: Encrypt a file with the public key; only the private key holder can decrypt it.

title: Steganography with Steghide
description: Hide and extract secret messages within image files using Steghide.

steps.title: Embed data in image
steps.command:
echo 'This is a secret message' > secret.txt
steghide embed -cf photo.jpg -sf secret.txt -p 'mypassword'
steps.output: embedding "secret.txt" in "photo.jpg"... done
steps.explanation: Steghide embeds the secret.txt data inside photo.jpg using AES-128 encryption.

steps.title: Extract hidden data
steps.output: wrote extracted data to "secret.txt".
steps.explanation: Extract the hidden data using the correct passphrase.
